findings.recommended_action: Obtain concrete landed cost quotes and verify breakage rates before market entry.
findings.strongest_case: No actual supplier quotes for landed cost components, unclear breakage rates, and payment processing fees reduce margin by 3% plus $0.30 per order, making margins unreliable.
findings.title: Contribution margin highly uncertain due to unverified landed cost assumptions

strongest_case_against_promotion: Sensitivity scenarios rely on broad assumptions with no actual quotes, lack of demand data, and uncertain regulatory and cost components, preventing reliable viability assessment.
